name: Oath of Nissa
oracle_text:
When Oath of Nissa enters, look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal a creature, land, or planeswalker card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
You may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast planeswalker spells.
blocked_sentences: You may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast planeswalker spells.

needs.what: the player-wide spend_mana_as_any_color static narrowed by an affects_spells filter (here {"types": ["Planeswalker"]}), loosening coloured pips only in the cast cost of spells matching the filter -- not activated-ability costs, not other spells
needs.why_existing_wont_do: spend_mana_as_any_color is unfiltered (Chromatic Orrery): it loosens every cost the player pays, spells and abilities alike, and the loader explicitly refuses 'affects'/'amount' on it; player_spends_mana_as_any_color takes no spell. The any_color flag on exile/grant_playable/look_at_top rides on one specific card made playable, not on a class of spells cast from hand.
